offering_description.value: Operates supermarkets that sell groceries, fresh foods, pharmacy products and fuel to households in the Mid-Atlantic and Northeast. Customers shop in company-owned stores, with in-store pharmacies and online ordering for pickup and delivery.

primary_products.value: grocery products; fresh meat and produce; dairy and bakery items; pharmacy products; general merchandise

primary_services.value: pharmacy services; online grocery pickup and delivery

customer_segment.value: B2C: households buying groceries, fuel, prescriptions and household goods

end_markets.value: retail grocery; pharmacy and healthcare; fuel retail

revenue_model.value: product sales: groceries, fresh foods, general merchandise and fuel sold in stores; healthcare reimbursement: prescription fills billed to insurers and government health programs

value_chain_position.value: retailer: sells packaged and fresh food to households through its own stores; service provider: provides pharmacy services to patients, billed to insurers and patients

geography_served.value: US regional: Pennsylvania, Maryland, New York, New Jersey, Virginia, West Virginia, Delaware and Connecticut

specialization.value: related lines: grocery, pharmacy, fuel and general merchandise sold through the same stores

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated supermarkets with in-store pharmacies and fuel stations; online: online ordering with store pickup and home delivery

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: food safety and sanitation rules from FDA and state agencies, plus state pharmacy licensing
